basics.name: Sundar Gurumurthy
basics.label: Computational Modelling Engineer
basics.summary: Computational engineer with 3+ years of hands-on experience in FEA, materials modeling, and design for manufacturing. Skilled in developing physics-based simulation workflows for WAAM, crashworthiness, and gear systems. Experienced in bridging academic research and industrial R&D through high-fidelity modeling and automation.

work.name: Cranfield University
work.summary: Research Assistant at the Welding and Additive Manufacturing Centre focused on Python/C++ simulation automation, thermal-mechanical modelling, reduced-order methods, and integration of laser-scan data with digital manufacturing workflows.
highlights: Built Python/C++ simulation automation pipelines for thermal-mechanical modelling and process-window analysis.
Developed phase-transformation strain models using test-driven statistical fitting and thermal-expansion datasets.
Integrated laser-scan data with simulation workflows for geometric conformity assessment and deviation-driven modelling.
Implemented rapid reduced-order approaches producing industry-usable simulation results in minutes.
Developed FORTRAN heat-source models and C++ Abaqus subroutines for nonstandard material and process cases.
Delivered technical reports, experimental analyses, and multi-stakeholder design reviews.

work.name: Sona Comstar
work.summary: Graduate Engineering Trainee in drivetrain systems, focusing on fatigue analysis, tolerance assessments, and manufacturing reviews for forging, machining and casting.
highlights: Performed fatigue, structural and tolerance assessments for drivetrain and differential systems.
Conducted forging DfM and manufacturing reviews for machining (soft → hard machining), broaching, grinding, polishing, and casting.
Defined operational load cases from torque maps and test data.
Automated CAD→FEA pipelines using Python/VBA to improve turnaround time.
Delivered stress reports, DFMEA documentation and supplier handover packages.

work.name: Mercedes-Benz R&D India
work.summary: Student Trainee in Crash Structures team, performing LS-Dyna modelling for tyre, rim and composite crash scenarios with a focus on Lagrangian contact optimisation.
highlights: Built LS-Dyna models for tyre, rim and composite crash scenarios.
Worked on Lagrangian contact optimisation for fibre-reinforced rubber composites.
Automated ANSA meshing using Python scripts.
Supported test–simulation correlation for modal and impact behaviour.
